scope: Independent read-only review of completed fixed-fixture native accessibility response-count timing

timing.origin: Immediately before append/open/write/flush through actual returned accessibility count observation; includes write and observation costs

bindingEvidence.uniquePidBeforeAndAfter: 41676, as recorded by native acceptance owner using read-only PowerShell and Sky in the task conversation
bindingEvidence.eachIncrement: Current returned Sky main window and same-PID fresh collector advance checks executed by reviewed helper, affirmed by native review receipt
bindingEvidence.endpointPixelVisibility: Native owner reviewed initial/final endpoint screenshots in the tool conversation; this independent audit checks the recorded binding and endpoint accessibility text

limitations: Helper remains timing-only; this review combines its completed run with the explicit native binding review and does not rewrite the helper gate.
Endpoint pixel visibility was reviewed by the native owner, not continuously sampled independently; exact pixel paint latency is not measured.
Per-event window/collector checks are enforced by the reviewed helper and attested by the native binding review; event JSONL does not retain every raw collector snapshot or full accessibility tree.
Prepared single-source content-free fixture contains ten baseline records plus twenty authored native usage records; it is not the raw multi-gigabyte recent-30-day import dataset.
Twenty serial observations meet the fixed-fixture threshold and do not claim concurrent load, throughput, whole desktop correctness, warm start, CPU/memory, installer or full M4 acceptance.
The current helper source hash is recorded for this review; the original run JSONL did not embed a helper-source digest.
The field latencyLowerMs in the original helper output is elapsed time from flush completion to observation; it is not used here as a proven lower bound on actual rendering latency.
No app launch, model request, UI interaction, source mutation or product test rerun was performed by this independent audit.
